entities.name: UniProt O15231 ZNF185
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed human Zinc finger protein 185 (689 aa).
Contains a C-terminal LIM zinc-binding domain at residues 627–689.
Long intrinsically disordered and compositionally biased regions span much of the N-terminal and central sequence.
Annotated cellular localizations include cytoplasm, actin cytoskeleton, cell junction, focal adhesion, plasma membrane, and cytosol.
May regulate cellular proliferation and/or differentiation.

entities.name: UniProt Q62394 Zfp185
observations: Reviewed mouse homolog of ZNF185 with 40.2% identity over 80.4% query coverage.
Carries a homologous C-terminal LIM zinc-binding domain and similar cytoskeletal/focal-adhesion localization annotations.

entities.name: ZNF185 sequence properties
observations: Length 689 aa; calculated molecular mass 73.5 kDa; theoretical pI 6.68; GRAVY −0.77; charge at pH 7 approximately −1.0.
Sequence is highly low-complexity/disorder-rich outside the C-terminal LIM region, consistent with a modular interaction/scaffolding protein.
